resources.name: Integral Care
resources.description: Get low-cost or free help for emotions and behavior, like stress, sadness, or worry. They also help with mental health medicine, crisis help, and support groups. Veterans can ask for staff who understand military life. They may help you find job help and other places too. You can call any time, day or night. Tell them you are a veteran and live in Travis County. They will do a quick phone check-up and help you plan next steps.
resources.availability_status: Open for new clients - call 24/7 for a phone check-up

resources.name: Texas Veterans Commission – Austin Office
resources.description: Get free help with jobs, resumes, and job search made for veterans. They also help with VA (Veterans Affairs) claims, education benefits, and other veteran programs. Staff are trained to work with people who served in the military. They can connect you to mental health help, housing help, and money help. You can call to set up a first visit or ask questions. Bring your DD-214 and any other papers you have from the military.
resources.availability_status: Open - call for visit times and walk-in hours

resources.name: Workforce Solutions Capital Area
resources.description: Get free help with job search, resumes, and job training in Travis County. Veterans can get priority help and may see a special veteran job coach. They can help you apply for training money, like for new job skills. They also help with job fairs and meeting hiring managers. Tell them you are a veteran when you call or visit. Bring your ID and work history if you can.
resources.availability_status: Open - some help by phone or online, call before you go

resources.name: VA Austin Outpatient Clinic (Central Texas Veterans Health Care System)
resources.description: Get mental health help, medical care, and support made for veterans. You can get help for post-traumatic stress (PTSD), sadness, worry, and drug or alcohol problems. They also have social workers who help with housing, money, and work support. You must be signed up for VA health care or ask how to sign up. Call to make a first visit or talk to the mental health team.
resources.availability_status: Open - some waits for non-urgent visits, call to schedule
resources.source: Verified via Central Texas Veterans Health Care System website

resources.name: Austin Vet Center
resources.description: Get free and private mental health help if you are a combat veteran or served in a war zone. You do not need to be in the VA health system to get help here. Call to ask who can get help and to set up a first visit.
resources.availability_status: Open - evening visits may be limited, call for times
